entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: GetStream reads another row, or throws, when the INTEGER primary key is not the rowid #39139
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #39138

Closed

  • Contradiction between `IReadOnlyTypeBase.ClrType` XML documentation and NRT annotation #39044
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39145
  • [release/11.0] Update xUnit v3 to 4.0.1 #39144
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0]: Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.63.1 to 3.63.2 #39142
    area-infrastructure
  • Write the entry that owns the ordinal in JSON collection element updates #39140
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/11.0] Allow EF.Parameter and EF.Constant on context properties in query filters #39091
    Servicing-approved, 11.0.0
  • [release/11.0] Fix JSON indexes for SQLite #39089
    Servicing-approved, api-review, 11.0.0
  • [release/11.0] Preserve ExecuteUpdate target joins during SQL tree pruning #39128
    Servicing-approved, 11.0.0
  • Normalize coverage paths #39123
  • [release/10.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.19.0 to 1.19.1 #39143
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0]: Bump Grpc.AspNetCore from 2.83.0 to 2.84.0 #39141
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39136
  • Remove efcore branch merge automation for release/11.0 RCs #39135
  • Align ClrType XML documentation with nullability contract #39088

Updated

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39097
  • [release/10.0] Fix Contains handling for read-only collections #39114
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.15
  • Materialize required collections absent from a JSON document as empty #39014
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Update stale nested complex collection entries during Update on a shortened collection #39092
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.15
  • Unescape doubled single quotes in scaffolded string default values #39101
    community-contribution
  • Fix and extend single-result subquery lifting #39107
    community-contribution
